material.acceptance_criteria: CI job 'tick shed window' prints 'average overrun rate over 5 pairs': shed=on mean < shed=off mean at the CI budget (100 us).
material.description: Shedding defers order drains only (room.rs step, budget.rs SHED_AFTER_OVERRUNS). Rescoped to the mean rate: over N=5 fixed 400-tick windows at a 100 us budget, the mean overrun rate with shedding on is lower than with shedding off. Hysteresis and deferral bounds are not part of this row.
material.subject: Tick budget overruns: shedding lowers the mean overrun rate at the CI budget
material.witness: CI run 39101571236 (head 9a29aa8), job 'tick shed window': 'average overrun rate over 5 pairs (report only): shed=off 0.2341 shed=on 0.1866' (dispatch 1792302671115-500-b8d7a14a5549ace9). Mean shed-on rate is lower than mean shed-off rate.
material.witness_plan: ci_log of the tick shed window job on the head run; read the averaged line.
